children: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds logged a second straight day of outflows. Continued withdrawals from BlackRock and Fidelity products pushed total net outflows over the two-day period above $770 million.

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net outflows of $137.94 million on Oct. 23, according to data from SoSoValue. Combined with the previous day's $635.49 million in net outflows, total withdrawals over the two sessions reached $773.43 million.

By product, BlackRock's IBIT posted the largest outflow at $110.34 million. Fidelity's FBTC also saw $31.78 million leave the fund. Morgan Stanley's MSBT, meanwhile, recorded net inflows of $4.19 million.
Grayscale's GBTC and BTC, Bitwise's BITB, and Ark 21Shares' ARKB each posted zero net inflows. Cumulative net inflows across all U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs stood at about $57.18 billion.

title: U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Second Straight Day of Outflows, With $137.94 Million Withdrawn
